description: Dash range readings at 100% charge. These are the truck's rolling estimate from recent driving, NOT a capacity measurement -- the same pack reads differently in different seasons and with different driving. Recorded as a band, never as a number.

readings.note: Read immediately after the KATHLEEN session. Odometer 40087 mi.

spread: 373 to 403 mi, about 8%, against an EPA rating of 381 that sits between them.
caution: Both ambient temperatures are assumed, not instrumented. Any temperature-versus-efficiency fit built on these two points inherits that softness and should widen its band accordingly.
